purpose: Define finite non-subjective performance evidence for future rebuilt gameplay on physical target iPhone without activating blocked gameplay gates.

optional_metrics.note: PerformanceLongTaskTiming is not a required pass signal because browser support is not universal.

guardrails: requestAnimationFrame cadence is display-dependent; do not require a fixed 60 Hz or 16.67 ms median.
Do not count hidden/background intervals as dropped gameplay frames because WebKit may suspend requestAnimationFrame and throttle timers while inactive.
Use timestamps/delta time for motion; never advance gameplay by a fixed amount per callback.
Long Tasks API evidence is optional and must not be required on Safari/iPhone when unsupported.
Automated or numeric PASS does not establish fun, responsiveness feel, audio quality, P1-006, P1-007, P1-008, or P1-009 human acceptance.
This contract authorizes evidence preparation only; collection begins only when the relevant rebuilt candidate is otherwise authorized.
research_basis: MDN Window.requestAnimationFrame: callback frequency generally follows display refresh rate; callbacks are paused in most background tabs; timestamp/delta-time based animation is required for high-refresh displays.
MDN Page Visibility API: visibilitychange is the supported signal for hidden/visible state; background requestAnimationFrame and timers may be paused/throttled.
WebKit How Web Content Can Affect Power Usage: inactive pages stop requestAnimationFrame and should avoid background CPU work.
MDN PerformanceLongTaskTiming: Long Tasks API is limited-availability, so it is optional rather than a Safari pass dependency.
